einzeiler: Guitarist Derek Trucks discusses the new album Future Soul, live residencies, and gear.
kurzfassung: Corey Wong welcomes back guitar virtuoso Derek Trucks to discuss their latest album Future Soul and working with producer Mike Elizondo. They explore the band's extensive residency at the Beacon Theatre, featuring surprise guest collaborations and famous instruments like Jerry Garcia's Tiger. Trucks also shares insights on mastering the guitar, the physical demands of touring, and memorable encounters with legends like Bonnie Raitt.
stichpunkte: Derek Trucks discusses the making of the new album Future Soul and collaborating with producer Mike Elizondo.
The album reflects a defiant, punk-inspired energy intended to bring joy amidst modern chaos and AI concerns.
Trucks reflects on the band's 10-night residency at the Beacon Theatre and playing historic guitars like Tiger.
The conversation covers memorable sit-ins during the Beacon run, including Cyndi Lauper and Warren Haynes.
Trucks shares auction stories, including acquiring Elvin Jones's historic timpanis and missing out on a Dwayne Allman SG.
The definition of musical mastery is discussed through the lens of longevity, intuition, and getting out of one's own way.
Trucks talks about the physical toll of finger-style playing without a pick during marathon live runs.
The hosts praise Bonnie Raitt's incredible talent, lasting legacy, and the special community fostered at the Sun, Sand, and Soul festival.

kapitel.titel: Touring, Physical Toll, and Bonnie Raitt

clips.hook: A defiant response to modern chaos
clips.text: The guest explains that the latest record serves as a rebellious and joyful antidote to an unstable world dominated by technological changes.

clips.hook: A massive number of unique songs performed
clips.text: The artist reveals the staggering quantity of distinct tracks played throughout a multi-night concert residency.
The guest shares a humorous anecdote about casually buying a rare tape machine on an online auction while visiting an amusement park with family.

clips.hook: Becoming a grandfather at a young age
clips.text: The guitar player drops a surprising personal milestone regarding his family while discussing the aging process.

clips.hook: Defending a performance against a disruptive audience member
clips.text: A legendary female musician once halted her show mid-song to reprimand a patron for blowing cigar smoke near the stage.

beschreibung:
We are absolutely thrilled to welcome back slide guitar legend Derek Trucks for his second appearance on the show. In this episode, we dive deep into the Tedeski Trucks Band's incredible new album, Future Soul, and discuss what it was like shaking things up with versatile producer Mike Elizondo. Derek also shares wild behind-the-scenes stories from their epic 10-night residency at the Beacon Theatre, including surprise sit-ins from icons like Cyndi Lauper and Jaimoe.
Guitar nerds, you won't want to miss this part: Derek tells us what it was actually like to play Jerry Garcia's legendary "Tiger" guitar and Frank Zappa’s fast-playing "Baby Snakes" guitar live on stage. We also swap stories from the Sun, Sand and Soul Festival, explore the true meaning of musical mastery, and discuss the physical toll of his unique hand-playing style. Tune in for a masterclass on the guitar and an unforgettable hang!
